title: Deepdelve hangs forever on 'Loading the mine...' when localStorage throws (Safari private mode, 'block all cookies')
steps: Context with window.localStorage getter throwing SecurityError (addInitScript)
expected: Game starts, progress simply not saved (like the other pages)
actual: Status stays 'Loading the mine...', no world, 4 uncaught 'denied' pageerrors; same setup without the throw loads in under 3 s.
suspect: game/games/deepdelve/deepdelve.js:138,160,190,192 (bare `localStorage` passed as an argument, evaluated outside try/catch)
retest: Boots in under 6 s with throwing localStorage (and sessionStorage): world rendered, note "Progress cannot be saved in this browser mode", 0 pageerrors. QA replay beta-retest-b15.test.js: ALL PASSED on port 9515.

title: Every page logs uncaught SecurityError pageerrors when localStorage access throws (hub, town, realm, isles, angler, dash, echo, jam, pop, stack, stalk)
expected: No uncaught exceptions; pages degrade to unsaved play
actual: 2-4 uncaught pageerrors per page. Pages still render and mostly work (only Deepdelve hard-fails, see b15-01) but unguarded accesses exist, so prefs/progress may silently fail.
suspect: page boot code reading localStorage outside try/catch (shared/mm-*.js and each page)
retest: Storage-blocked sweep (localStorage + sessionStorage getters throw, 390x844, 5 s each): 0 pageerrors on hub, town (join screen), realm, isles, angler, dash, echo, jam, pop, stack, stalk, deepdelve, bug safari; 0 DB requests. Lantern (not in the round-1 list) still throws once, filed as b15-r2-16.

title: Hub at 200% zoom on a phone (195 css px wide) clips the title, truncates every card to 2 letters and cuts off the bottom bar
steps: Viewport 195x422 DPR2 touch (= 390px phone at 200% zoom), save with a Continue target
expected: Single-column cards with readable names; reflow without clipping
actual: 'PIXELTOWN' title overlapped by the Menu compass button, card titles read 'To...', 'Is...', 'Th...', the 'Next:' line is ellipsised, bottom action bar cut off at the left with 'Daily gift' wrapping. Cards stay 2-column.
retest: 195x422@2x with a Continue target: one column, cards 175 px wide with full names ("Town / Walk and fish"), Next line wraps, bottom bar is a single "<- Town" button, scrollWidth 195 (no horizontal scroll). Nit: the yellow moon decoration overlaps the end of the PIXELTOWN logo (b15-r2-18).

title: Realm HUD is crowded at 320x568: Leave button collides with the XP bar, goal line truncated, twin sticks plus 4 ability buttons cover much of the playfield
expected: HUD fits without overlap on the smallest supported phone
actual: Top-left stack (compass, HP, XP) collides with Leave; status chips ('Shore - Safe-ish', 'Raid in 0:2...', 'Next goal: Reach Lv 5 for M...') clipped; 2x2 ability pad and both joysticks leave about 35% of the screen for the world.
retest: Partially fixed. Leave no longer collides (see b15-11), but at 320x568 the info line "Lv 1  Shore  0 shards" is still overprinted by the XP bar and the zone chip, and the 2x2 ability pad + both sticks + coach card still cover most of the playfield.

title: Town on a landscape phone (844x390): Realm Gate pointer chip, quick-chat row and 'Hold to talk' overlap world content and each other; the chip covers a villager
steps: Town via offline stub, join, rotate to 844x390
actual: Pointer chip sits under 'Where to?' and over an NPC; quick-chat row and Hold to talk cover the Shop / Able Sisters labels. Still playable.
retest: 844x390 offline town: quick-chat row (Hi / lol / Fishing / Nice / Bye) over the world top-left, Realm Gate chip (x639..836, y116..162) sits right under "Where to?" and over the statue/NPC, "Hold to talk" covers the Able Sisters label. Unchanged.

title: At 320x568 the 'Back to the map' pill overlaps the Hearthvale title icon
actual: Pill covers the island emoji and top of the title.
retest: 320x568 join screen: the pill now reads "<- Home" but still covers the island emoji above HEARTHVALE (the title text itself is clear).

title: games/arcane-frontier/index.html is a half-committed scaffold: style.css and 14 scripts return 404, page unstyled with 648 px horizontal scroll at 320 wide
actual: 404 for style.css and js/{assets,save,audio,input,map,fx,combat,items,player,bosses,enemies,world,ui,main}.js; raw unstyled UI, canvas#bigmap 648 px wide. Not linked from hub but publicly reachable.
retest: /game/games/arcane-frontier/index.html still answers 200 with 15 failing requests (404 style.css, js/assets.js, js/save.js, js/map.js, ...), scrollWidth 648 at 320 wide.

title: No service worker: reload or navigation while offline shows the browser error page on every page
steps: Load any page, go offline, reload or follow a link to another game
expected: Cached shell or friendly offline message
actual: Chrome ERR_INTERNET_DISCONNECTED. In-page play continues offline (Town Menu opened, scene stayed active). manifest.json exists but nothing registers a service worker.
retest: No navigator.serviceWorker registration anywhere in game/ (grep). Offline reload not re-run; status by code inspection.

title: Hub 'Next step' card is focusable but shows no visible focus ring
actual: Play button has a ring, the second stop ('Next step: ...') has none.
retest: Hub Tab x2 focuses #home-next: its border changes rgb(29,43,83) -> rgb(255,163,0) on focus (visible orange ring).

title: Dash, Echo, Pop, Stack expose only 4-5 Tab stops; Isles only Pack / Soothe / Menu (canvas not keyboard-reachable by Tab)
expected: Canvas / primary action reachable by keyboard with a role and label
actual: Dash: Menu, Sound, Jump, Got it. Isles: Pack, Soothe shots, Menu. Consistent with the known a11y sweep; confirming.
retest: Partially fixed: Echo, Pop and Stack now expose a labelled focusable canvas ("Pixel Pop board: t...", etc.). Dash has no canvas stop (Jump button covers it). Isles: Pack, Soothe shots, Close how to play, Menu; canvas still not a Tab stop. New nit b15-r2-17: the second Tab on the minis lands on <body>.

title: Leave button overlaps the XP bar on 320x568 and 360x640 (measured); 2560x1440 is clean
steps: Compare #realm-leave-btn and #realm-xp rects (also visible in b15-03)
actual: #realm-leave-btn x64..146,y54..98 vs #realm-xp x8..118,y82..100: about 54x16 px overlap at both widths, so a Leave tap lands on the XP text. At 2560x1440 Leave sits top-right with no overlap against HP, info or XP.
retest: Measured with a hero in play: 320x568 Leave x230..312 y54..98 vs XP x8..118 y82..100 = 0 px overlap; 360x640 Leave x270..352, 0 overlap; no overlap with HP or Menu either.

title: Craft list shows raw ids as labels: 'plank > plank', 'brick > brick', 'stew > stew', 'bugjar > bugjar'
expected: Readable recipe names with output quantity
actual: Each row title is 'name > name' (same word twice), lower-case, no output quantity.
retest: Craft rows read Plank, Brick, Stew, Bugjar, Pie, Crown, Chime, Lantern, Wreath, Umbrella, each with its ingredient line.

title: Browser Back (phone back gesture) while the shared Menu is open leaves the page instead of closing the Menu
steps: Open Hub, press Start on pad or the Menu button
actual: Navigates to the previous page; the Menu is not history-aware (Isles: Esc opens the Menu, Back leaves). Back and forward between pages otherwise work on all 12 pages with no errors.
retest: Hub (arrived from Pop): Menu opened (#mm-nav-sheet visible), browser Back -> navigated to games/pop/index.html. No popstate/pushState in game/shared. Esc closes the Menu correctly and focus stays trapped in the sheet (4/4 Tabs inside).

title: First-visit 'How to play' card has no close control and stays up (pointer-events none, no buttons)
steps: New save, open Isles on 390x844, walk around
expected: Dismiss button or fade after first move
actual: Card (about 193 px tall) stays visible after movement; non-blocking for taps but it hides the playfield and is not dismissible by keyboard or screen reader.
retest: Isles first visit at 390x844: the How-to card (193 px) now has a close button ("Close how to play", reachable by Tab) and is gone after a tap + walking (~6 s).

title: Realm HUD at 150% zoom (260x563): Menu button drops onto the XP bar, info line hidden, coach text one word per line
steps: Phone 260x563 touch (390x844 at 150% zoom), fresh profile
expected: HUD wraps without overlap at 150% zoom
actual: #realm-menu-btn x64..108 y54..98 vs #realm-xp x8..118 y82..100 = 44x16 px overlap (the '0 / 30 xp' bar is drawn across the bottom of the Menu button); 'Lv 1 Shore' line hidden behind XP / zone chip; coach 'Drag the left stick to walk around.' wraps one word per line; ability pad + sticks cover about 60% of the screen. Leave is clear.
suspect: game/realm-ui.css narrow-width HUD rules (below ~300 px the Menu button wraps to row 2 under the compass)

title: Dash, Echo, Pop, Stack: the second Tab press lands on <body> (focus vanishes) before reaching Sound

actual: Tab order: Menu, (body, nothing visible), SOUND ON, canvas, GOT IT. Same dead stop on all four minis.
